claims: NASA owns the Artemis II mission.
NASA leads the Artemis II mission.
Lockheed Martin built the Orion capsule.
Boeing built the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket core.
NASA's Exploration Ground Systems team based at Kennedy Space Center owns the Artemis II mission.
Lockheed Martin is the prime contractor for the Orion spacecraft.
Airbus developed modules and systems for the Orion spacecraft.
Boeing developed the core stage of the Space Launch System (SLS).
Northrop Grumman developed the solid rocket boosters of the SLS.
Lockheed Martin officially handed over the finished Orion capsule to NASA on May 1, 2025.
Artemis II incorporates components from commercial partners such as SpaceX and Blue Origin.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled for a crewed fly-around of the Moon in 2026.
The Artemis II mission features astronauts from NASA.
The Artemis II mission features astronauts from the Canadian Space Agency.
